property_summary: For any initialize(...) call the contract's stored changeFee equals the _changeFee argument passed (reference preserves input); the mutant that sets changeFee = 0 breaks this because stored changeFee will be 0 even when _changeFee != 0.
change_summary: Replace assignment to changeFee with assignment that sets changeFee to zero, so stored changeFee after initialize becomes 0 regardless of input.
